mini.fire_scan.goal.en: Send the fire data to the ground station
mini.fire_scan.goal.zh-TW: 把火點資料送進下傳站

mini.fire_scan.link.en: A satellite sees far more data than it can send down. Fire detections go first so crews can be alerted early; clouds and noise can wait.
mini.fire_scan.link.zh-TW: 衛星拍到的資料遠比能下傳的多，所以火點資料要先送，消防單位才來得及出動；雲和雜訊可以晚點再說。

mini.fire_scan.hint.en: Red flame cards only, leave the grey ones
mini.fire_scan.hint.zh-TW: 只點紅色火焰卡，灰色的別碰
